pr_title: br: add summary to stream restore
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

BR restore point command has no summary. User don't know whether it finished successfully.

Issue Number: close #35236

Problem Summary: BR restore point command has no summary.

### What is changed and how it works?

Add summary to tell user success or failed

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No code

1. exec restore point with full backup successfully

![restore_success](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13897016/172599763-9f638831-922b-46d9-bdb9-2afc701708df.png)

2. exec restore point without full backup successfully

![restore_point_success](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13897016/172599921-cf1d5237-a177-4dca-8876-95d304b68163.png)

3. exec restore point without full backup failed

![restore_point_failed](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13897016/172600144-2cbe2682-731e-4de4-8431-ee061df8adca.png)

### Release note
